page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text. Running head at top right, page number at top left. A catchword sits alone at the lower right below the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: scripta, & captu non facilia, nisi quis fuerit in illis diu versatus. Præterea, ordi-narii Characteres quamquam Persici & Arabici, ad imprimendas Ephemerides fortasse non sufficerent ob notarica quædam, quibus multis opus est Literarum compendia. Insuper amanuensem non habeo, qui mihi Persica transcribat, & ipse nec labori sufficio, nec patientia mihi est, ut transcribendo me fatigem, & tempus conteram. Nullo autem remanente apud me transumpto unicum, quod habeo originale, ut imprimatur, alio transmittere cum discrimine illius amissionis in itenere procul dubio permolestum esset. Nihilominus tamen fortasse difficultates istas superabo, & Ephemeridem integram ad te mittam utroque charactere, Latino nempe & Persico, si fieri poterit ἀμφιγνῶσαν[?] imprimendam: interim ex ea deliba, quæ in alia charta huic Epistolæ eligata separatim mitto; ac me fac, quæso certiorem, num Parisiis, ubi typos Arabicos reperiri certissimum est Persica etiam imprimi pos-

page.notes: The Greek word after "poterit" is hard to read in the scan; the reading ἀμφιγνῶσαν is doubtful and marked [?]. The catchword "sint" is printed in the long-s face and looks like "fint"; read as "sint" and marked [?]. The word "aliò" is printed with a grave accent and is kept as printed. The paragraph continues onto the next page, so the final word of the page is hyphenated as "pos-".
